title: An Explainable AI Framework for Predicting and Prioritizing Security Risks in AI-Generated Software Code
summary: Detects vulnerabilities in AI-generated code, classifies them by CWE type, scores and ranks risk, and explains each prediction. Evaluated on DiverseVul and AI-generated C functions; IEEE conference format.

title: Performance-Preserving Feature Selection for Explainable Multiclass Intrusion Detection on CICIDS2017
summary: Random Forest, Decision Tree and XGBoost with feature selection that keeps accuracy, and SHAP explanations for each prediction.
